external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
external_entities.notes: Colleagues sign in from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store who is vouched for by the franchise's identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies group membership changes and leaver changes overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: An identity provider operated by the franchise that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not state which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

external_entities.name: franchise store
external_entities.description: A franchise store whose colleagues are admitted through their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: The broker signs colleagues in, issues tokens, accepts federated sign-ins, and supplies public signing-key material to applications.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: Tokens are good for twelve hours and there is no way to pull one back before it expires. The text does not state whether colleagues are asked for a second factor.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses broker-issued tokens to authorize price changes and transaction voids across stores.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their groups.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state whether the directory is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what that log records or whether it covers the franchise route. The text does not state whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are
data_flows.data_description: unknown

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.data_description: A token carrying the colleague's staff id and group list

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: A colleague presents a broker-issued token to the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token
data_flows.data_description: A token carrying the colleague's staff id and group list

data_flows.name: fetch public half
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the broker's signing key.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: Public half of the signing key

data_flows.name: keep signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps the signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_flows.notes: The same key signs the tokens for every application.
data_flows.data_description: Signing key

data_flows.name: send changes
data_flows.description: The HR system supplies group membership and leaver changes to the identity broker overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.notes: The broker pulls the changes once a night.
data_flows.data_description: Group membership changes and leaver changes

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker updates its directory with colleagues and their groups.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_flows.data_description: Colleagues and their group memberships

data_flows.name: vouch sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.
data_flows.data_description: A sign-in assertion for a franchise colleague

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague presents a broker-issued token to the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us
data_flows.data_description: A token carrying the colleague's staff id and group list

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: Nobody has written down what that log records or whether it covers the franchise route.
data_flows.data_description: Sign-in events

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: own device at home
trust_boundaries.description: A home device used by a colleague to sign in from home.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home.

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-controlled environment from which franchise colleagues are admitted.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The colleague's staff id is personal information.
assumptions.basis: The directory contains colleagues and their group memberships, including staff identities.
It contains colleague identities and group memberships.
The key store contains the signing key used to sign tokens.
